latestVersion.changelog: Agent Workflow v1.0.0 — Initial release. A structured workflow plugin for OpenClaw agents. Migrated and adapted from the superpowers workflow system (originally designed for Claude Code) into a general-purpose, code-agnostic workflow engine. Features: full workflow state machine (brainstorm → plan → execute → verify → deliver), persistent state across sessions, multi-project concurrency, branch support, context-plugins for parallel forks, soft-guard goto, and 11 bundled Skills covering the full workflow lifecycle. Includes agent_workflow tool with actions: start, status, next, goto, complete, fork, join, getSkill, list, abandon.
